name: get_rcsb_pdb_metadata
description: Retrieve 3D structure metadata for a protein from the RCSB Protein Data Bank using a 4-character PDB ID. Returns information such as resolution, experimental method, and chain composition. Use this tool when you have a specific PDB ID (e.g. '1A0A'). Do NOT use this tool for searching or querying by other identifiers; use 'search_rcsb_pdb' for broader queries.

parameters.name: pdb_id
parameters.description: The 4-character PDB ID representing the protein structure (e.g. '1A0A'). Must be exactly 4 characters long and alphanumeric. The function raises an error if the ID is invalid or not found.

parameters.name: include_chain_composition
parameters.description: Whether to include detailed chain composition in the response. Set to false to reduce response size if only resolution and method are needed. Defaults to true.

resolution.description: Resolution of the structure in angstroms (e.g. 1.5).

experimental_method.description: The method used to determine the structure (e.g. 'X-ray diffraction', 'NMR').

chain_composition.description: List of chains in the structure, including their identifiers and types. Only present if include_chain_composition=true.

return_schema.description: Metadata including PDB ID, resolution, experimental method, and optional chain composition.
